qualification.education_qualification: Graduate, Degree/Diploma in Physiotherapy, M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology, Post Graduate in Prosthetics & Orthotics
qualification.details: Lecturer (Prosthetics & Orthotics): Post Graduate in Prosthetics & Orthotics from a recognized University/ Institute. 10 Years of teaching experience in the relevant field from a recognized Institute / Rehabilitation Organization / College/ University. Clinical Psychologist-cum- Junior Lecturer: M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology (2 years course). Registration with RCI is mandatory. Two years' experience as Clinical Psychologist in a recognized Disability Institute / Organization. Demonstrator in Physiotherapy: Degree/Diploma in Physiotherapy. Three years teaching experience. Cashier: Graduate in Commerce. Minimum 5 years experience in Accounts of Government Department or Public Sector Undertaking out of which at least 2 years should be in handling cash transaction.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the SVNIRTAR Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 26-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of SVNIRTAR to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SVNIRTAR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 26 October 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SVNIRTAR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for various posts in the Swami Vivekanand National Institute of Rehabilitation Training and Research (SVNIRTAR) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for SVNIRTAR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee varies by category. General/OBC/EWS candidates need to pay Rs.1000/-, SC/ST candidates need to pay Rs.500/-, and PwD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for the Cashier post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Cashier post is a Graduate degree in Commerce. Additionally, 5 years of experience in Accounts is necessary.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Clinical Psychologist-cum- Junior Lecturer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Clinical Psychologist-cum- Junior Lecturer post is 30 years. Age relaxations will be applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for SVNIRTAR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will involve a Written Test, followed by an Interview and a Skill Test for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply offline for SVNIRTAR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted online only through the official website. A hard copy of the application also needs to be sent via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Lecturer post?
faq.answer: The Lecturer (Prosthetics & Orthotics) post offers a salary in Pay Matrix Level-10, ranging from Rs. 56,100/- to Rs. 1,77,500/-.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article or directly from the SVNIRTAR official website.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of SVNIRTAR?
faq.answer: Swami Vivekanand National Institute of Rehabilitation Training and Research (SVNIRTAR) is located in Cuttack, Odisha, with the pincode 754010.
